postnatal.careBody: Wannan sarari don kula da bayan haihuwa — hutu, warkewa, da bin likitoci. Bin diddigin jariri yana daban.
postnatal.pastDueHint: Ranar haihuwarku ta wuce. Idan ka haihu, danna Na haihu don fara kula da bayan haihuwa na mahaifiya. Idan kana buƙatar ajiye wannan ciki a sirri, yi amfani da Rufe wannan ciki a ƙasa.
postnatal.birthSubtitle: Za mu canza zuwa kula da bayan haihuwa na mahaifiya. Ƙarorin TT ku suna kan wannan allo.
postnatal.finishMessage: Za mu adana wannan cikin haihuwa a matsayin haihuwa, share tsarin lokacin ciki, kuma dawo da Period Tracker idan an dakatar. Ƙarorin TT ku suna ajiye.
postnatal.closeMessage: Za mu ajiye tsarin lokacin ciki. Rubutun kula da mahaifiya kamar ƙarorin TT suna ajiye, kuma Period Tracker zai iya dawowa. Ka ɗauki lokacin da kake buƙata — ba ka kadai ba.
postnatal.heroSubtitle: Ka mai da hankali kan warkewarku. Rubutun TT ku yana nan.
postnatal.birthDisclaimer: Bin diddiga na ilimi kawai — bi shawarwarin bayan haihuwar asibitin ku.
postnatal.finishTitle: A gama kula da bayan haihuwa?
postnatal.notActive: Saita tsarin lokacin ciki mai aiki kafin rubuta haihuwa.
